description: The pie chart visually represents four key dimensions of a reasoning benchmark for large language models (LLMs), as introduced in the paper “Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge: An Ever-Scaling Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs.” The chart is divided into four equal quadrants, each labeled with a core attribute and accompanied by an icon and a descriptive tag. The top-left yellow quadrant is labeled “Complexity,” marked with a ladder icon and the tag “Uncrushable,” suggesting resilience or depth in problem structure. The top-right light blue quadrant is labeled “Instance,” with a shield-and-checkmark icon and the tag “Unhackable,” implying robustness against adversarial manipulation. The bottom-right green quadrant is labeled “Coverage,” featuring a globe-and-gear icon and the tag “General,” indicating broad applicability across domains. The bottom-left red quadrant is labeled “Scalable Oversight,” with a document-and-check icon and the tag “Auto-gradable,” highlighting the ability to evaluate performance automatically at scale. Each quadrant occupies exactly 25% of the pie, visually emphasizing their equal importance in the benchmark’s design. The chart uses color-coded callouts to link each quadrant to its descriptive tag, reinforcing the conceptual framework of the benchmark.
